subject: Children's Book Author Kat Picarde
overview: Host Danielle Balocca interviewed local author and teacher Kat Picarde about the inspiration for her children's books and her experiences in the publishing industry. Picarde discussed her transition to self-publishing and her work coaching aspiring writers.

items.title: Introduction and Medford Favorites
items.summary: Kat Picarde introduced herself as a first-grade teacher and children's book author while sharing her favorite local dining spots in Medford.

items.title: The Little Ouch, Twin Time, and Ollie and Stella
items.summary: Picarde described the themes of her three books, which address medical anxiety, her childhood as a twin in Medford, and family adventures.

items.title: Publishing Models and Economics
items.summary: The author detailed her transition from hybrid publishing to self-publishing to better manage production costs and royalties.

items.title: Author Coaching and The Aspiring Author Planner
items.summary: Picarde discussed her work providing coaching calls for new authors and her creation of a guided journal to help writers navigate the manuscript process.

items.title: Local Availability and Upcoming Events
items.summary: The interview concluded with information on where to purchase the books locally and an announcement for a story time event at Moon and Back Bookstore on April 19.
